facts.fact: Askanwi reports Gamcel cut its standard price of 1 GB of data from D130 to D60 by 8 January 2026, without promotions, under the regulator PURA's D75 per GB ceiling.
Askanwi reports Comium, Africell and QCell charged D65 for 1 GB of standard data in January 2026.
